state: Pending exact independent admission review; no self-approval
preservation: All prior20 source/review bytes and all original staging packets stay unchanged. Only reviewer metadata is projected into the thirteen compile rows; lexical/example fields are identical.

scopeNotes.bank transfer: No unconditional wire transfer alias; generic account transfer scope only.
scopeNotes.letting agent: UK rental-arranging person/company; not every estate-sales agent.
scopeNotes.medical certificate: Broader medical/fitness document; do not replace unconditionally with a sick note or claim universal acceptance requirements.
scopeNotes.missed connection: Subsequent transport leg only; not generic missed departure or romantic encounter.
scopeNotes.travel insurance: No promise of medical or any other coverage beyond policy terms.
scopeNotes.check in online: Selected airline verb phrase, not a noun or every possible hotel use.
scopeNotes.academic transcript: Definition does not force official-only status; no degree/attendance-certificate alias.
scopeNotes.resit an exam: Repeat exam, not necessarily a first attempt postponed through special consideration. UK verb forms resat/resitting; no regular resited.
scopeNotes.take notes: Recording information, distinct from take note meaning pay attention.
scopeNotes.probation period: Employment suitability only; no criminal probation, fixed duration or unpaid-work claim.
scopeNotes.hand in one's notice: Employee resignation notification only; no universal generic give notice or all job-ending equivalence.

separatePlanNotAdmitted: side effects remains a separate finite morphology change; not a new head in this cohort.
